title: The Black Dog
text: A black dog the size of a calf pads beside the party for a mile, saying nothing, its paws making no sound on the stones. Its eyes are wet and red. Then it sits in the road and looks at one of you, only one, the way a dog looks at its master.

options.label: The one it looks at meets its red eyes, and does not look away.

outcomes.text: It wags its tail once, slowly, then goes. This time, it was only looking.
It was not only looking. It knows them now, and it will come again at the end, when they are alone.

options.label: Feed it, and hope that is all it came for.

outcomes.text: It eats with a crunch of bone, then leaves. It does not come back for anyone, not yet.

options.label: Drive it off with fire. No dog that size means well.

outcomes.text: It leaves without hurry. Some day it will return for someone, and it will not have forgotten the fire.
